Short biography

Nolan Kido is interested in technology, decision-making, and creative work. He explores how useful tools and clear thinking can help people learn, make decisions, and communicate ideas.

A little more context

Nolan Kido explores technology, decision-making, and creative work. His interests include practical uses of artificial intelligence, analytical problem-solving, visual storytelling, and learning across disciplines. He is drawn to turning complicated ideas into useful tools and clear explanations, with an emphasis on experimentation, evidence, and thoughtful execution. His personal website brings together a concise introduction and occasional notes on tools, decisions, and learning.
